---
title: "MB1A Practical 4"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)

insect_counts = read.csv("data/insect_counts.csv")
flower_counts = read.csv("data/flower_counts.csv")
site_metadata = read.csv("data/site_metadata.csv")

site_count = nrow(site_metadata)
print(site_count)

total_insect_obs = insect_counts |>  #define variables
  pull(n_observed) |>  #pull data from column
  sum()                #sum data in column
print(total_insect_obs)

insect_totals = insect_counts |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(n_obs = sum(n_observed))

insect_totals = insect_totals |>
  arrange(desc(n_obs)) 

gt(head(insect_totals))

```
From this, we can see that the total number of unique sites is 76, the total number of insects observed is 15126, and the species with the greatest number of observations is Episyrphus balteatus, with 1034 observations recorded.

```{r}

htum_counts = insect_counts |>
  filter(species == "Halictus tumulorum")
gt(head(htum_counts))

ht_df = htum_counts |>
  mutate(detected = n_observed > 0)
gt(head(ht_df))

ht_df = ht_df |>
  inner_join(site_metadata)

gt(head(ht_df))
write.csv(ht_df, "output/ht_df.csv")
```

```{r}
ht_temp_df <- ht_df |>
  select(x1km_square, detected, min_temp_coldest_month)

ht_temp_summ <- ht_temp_df |>
  group_by(detected) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(min_temp_coldest_month),
    sd = sd(min_temp_coldest_month),
    count = n()
  )

# Separate present and absent sites
present <- ht_temp_summ |>
  filter(detected == TRUE)

absent <- ht_temp_summ |>
  filter(detected == FALSE)

gt(ht_temp_summ)

gt(present)

gt(absent)
```

```{r}
ggplot(ht_df,
       aes(x=detected, y=min_temp_coldest_month, fill=detected)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  ggtitle("Minimum Temperature with and without H. tumulorum - Observed") +
  xlab("Presence of H. tumulorum") +
  ylab("Minimum temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
t.test(min_temp_coldest_month ~ detected, data = ht_temp_df, var.equal = TRUE)
```

```{r}
lm_ht = lm(min_temp_coldest_month ~ detected, data = ht_temp_df)
```

```{r}
lm_ht = lm(min_temp_coldest_month ~ detected, data = ht_temp_df)
summ_lm_ht = summary(lm_ht)
print(summ_lm_ht)
```
```{r}
confint(lm_ht)
```
```{r}
anova(lm_ht)
```
There is evidence that minimum temperature in the coldest month differs between sites where H. tumulorum is present and sites where it is absent (𝐹(1, 74) = 32.79, 𝑝 = 2.07e-07, 𝑅2 = 0.307). The model explains approximately 30.7% of the variation in minimum temperature in the coldest month.
